clock.sys_cnt.frequency_mhz.description: Measured SYS_CNT interval [999.923515, 1000.122079] MHz, rounded to 1000 MHz. Not compute-core frequency.

clock.device_compute.frequency_mhz.description: Configured compute clock, not SYS_CNT or runtime telemetry.

simd.vector_width_bits.description: 256-byte vector register width; not instruction throughput.

simt.warp_size.description: Direct ACL_DEV_ATTR_WARP_SIZE query on Ascend950DT_9582, return code 0. Not inferred from PR.

simd.f32.add.throughput.description: DT measured saturated source vector ADD throughput; ILP 4/6/8 sweep, 64 FP32 lanes per source vector ADD. Not dependent latency.

simd.f32.add.dependent_latency.description: Measured dependent source-vadd latency. The value is the mean of two independent physical runs and two chain-length slopes per run; all 252 checks passed.

simt.f32.add.throughput.description: DT measured effective source scalar ADD rate, 32 launched warps, ILP8. Not throughput per individual thread.

simt.setup.empty.description: Measured minimal VF enqueue slope at 32 warps, including device loop and one observable UB store; no per-iteration barrier. Not isolated transition latency.

simt.setup.empty_with_barrier.description: Repeated fresh serialized minimal-VF slope at 32 warps, including one observable UB store and PIPE_ALL per iteration. Mean of the 200-to-400 slopes from two runs; not the sum of isolated enter/exit costs.

simd.setup.minimal_with_barrier.description: Repeated fresh minimal observable SIMD Stage slope, including one vdup, one UB vector store and PIPE_ALL per iteration. Mean of the 200-to-400 slopes from two runs; this is a Stage setup proxy, not an isolated instruction latency.

simt.shuffle.throughput.description: Correctness-checked effective source shfl_up rate at 32 warps, ILP4, including loop control. Assembly review pending; not isolated instruction peak.

simt.shuffle.dependent_latency.description: Measured one-warp dependent shfl_up source latency. The value is the mean of two independent physical runs and two chain-length slopes per run; all 252 checks passed.

simt.gm.load.throughput.description: Measured effective GM-path workload rate, including arithmetic/control. Active footprint changes from 32 to 128 MiB; not pure HBM bandwidth. See evidence limitations.

simt.gm.store.throughput.description: Measured effective GM-path workload rate, including arithmetic/control. Active footprint changes from 32 to 128 MiB; not pure HBM bandwidth. See evidence limitations.

simt.gm.load.bandwidth.description: Measured effective GM-path workload rate, including arithmetic/control. Active footprint changes from 32 to 128 MiB; not pure HBM bandwidth. See evidence limitations.

simt.gm.store.bandwidth.description: Measured effective GM-path workload rate, including arithmetic/control. Active footprint changes from 32 to 128 MiB; not pure HBM bandwidth. See evidence limitations.

simt.ub.load.throughput.description: Measured effective UB workload rate including arithmetic/address/control. Full sink and store validation. Not pure hardware bandwidth or latency.

simt.ub.store.throughput.description: Measured effective UB workload rate including arithmetic/address/control. Full sink and store validation. Not pure hardware bandwidth or latency.

simt.ub.load.bandwidth.description: Measured effective UB workload rate including arithmetic/address/control. Full sink and store validation. Not pure hardware bandwidth or latency.

simt.ub.store.bandwidth.description: Measured effective UB workload rate including arithmetic/address/control. Full sink and store validation. Not pure hardware bandwidth or latency.

simd.gm.load.continuous_dma.description: Per-AIV continuous GM-to-UB DMA slope from a joint least-squares fit of two independent 4/32/128 KiB sweeps. The paired startup measurement must be charged once per logical transfer.

simd.gm.load.continuous_dma_startup.description: Intercept of the same GM-to-UB fit; it is a per-logical-transfer startup, not kernel setup.

simd.gm.store.continuous_dma.description: Per-AIV continuous UB-to-GM DMA slope from a joint least-squares fit of two independent 4/32/128 KiB sweeps. The paired startup measurement must be charged once per logical transfer.

simd.gm.store.continuous_dma_startup.description: Intercept of the same UB-to-GM fit; it is a per-logical-transfer startup, not kernel setup.

simd.control.dependent_fadd_pair_delta.description: Increment from one to two dependent scalar fadd instructions in the same SIMD loop body. Mean of two fresh pair runs; optimized LLVM IR contains one versus two surviving fadd instructions. This delta is evidence for formula review, not yet a scalar-throughput profile parameter.

simt.control.one_warp_loop_plus_fadd.description: One-warp loop containing one dependent fadd per lane. Mean of two fresh runs. It combines loop/control and arithmetic and therefore is not an isolated loop-backedge latency.

simt.control.thirty_two_warp_loop_plus_f.description: Thirty-two-warp loop containing one dependent fadd per lane. Mean of two fresh runs. The 38.7855-cycle value and the non-linear 1/2/4/8/16/32-warp sweep prove that one constant loop_backedge_system_cycles cannot represent both dependency and shared-issue effects.

simd.prefix_scan.fit_intercept.description: Intercept of the correctness-checked SIMD prefix-scan fit C=intercept+(axis_extent-1)*row_step for one vector group. It includes seed load/store and fixed serialized Stage work; it is not a generic kernel setup constant.

simd.prefix_scan.row_step.description: Slope per additional scan-axis row for one <=64-lane vector group in the same SIMD prefix-scan fit. Two runs agree within 0.03%; extrapolation to multiple vector groups still requires validation.

simt.prefix_scan.rows_4_columns_8.description: End-to-end serialized SIMT Kogge-Stone prefix scan for 8 independent sequences of extent 4. This validates a concrete point but is not promoted to a single dependency factor because warp count and scan depth are separate dimensions.

simt.prefix_scan.rows_32_columns_32.description: End-to-end serialized SIMT Kogge-Stone prefix scan for 32 independent sequences of extent 32. This validates a concrete point but is not promoted to a single dependency factor because warp count and scan depth are separate dimensions.
